title: Looking for an Adjustable Weighted Vest Thats Compact/Less Bulky - Priced within Reason
body:
Hi all,
Looking for an adjustable weighted vest recommendations (or hacks) that are priced within reason
Ive tired this 9-18kg-adjustable-weighted-vest by anko - from kmart priced at $59
Whilst the Anko one is good, it's 'puffier' than expected. (uses some sandy-like stuff in bags for the weights)
I am a large guy - looking for a more compact version that fits closer to the body/ chest.
This one from Nordic Fitness costs $189 (ridiculous) (would have jumped on it - if it was $100 and under)
https://www.nordicfitness.com.au/products/venom-weighted-ves…
Any tips or places to get better deals on such things? (pre-owned/ second-hand is ok too)
Thanks
—
